name: Taga (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Taga town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed base above a curved stroke, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Taga, a town in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1967.

features.role: Taga town emblem — a ring with a pointed base above a curved stroke, like a stylised character
